context: A mom hears about her young son's day
purpose: Teach: いままで/スッキリ/ヒマ/居心地/悲しく/全開/鳴らし/立ち上がり

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日いままででいちばん楽しかったよ!
lines.en: Mom, today was the best fun I've had!
lines.style: Bright, unselfconscious joy. Quick-paced, energetic opening. Slight breathlessness from excitement. Eyes wide. No filter between thought and voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: よかったね。スッキリした顔してる。
lines.en: That's wonderful. You look so happy.
lines.style: Warm, genuine. Soft smile in the voice. Slow, observant pace. Meeting his joy without overdoing it. The comfort of being truly seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お昼休み、ヒマな時間に皆で笛鳴らし合いっこした!
lines.en: During lunch break, all of us were blowing whistles at each other in the free time!
lines.style: Rapid, tumbling speech. Words stacked on top of each other with childlike enthusiasm. Laughing a little while speaking. The kind of detail-sharing that expects adult amazement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 居心地のいいクラスね。誰か悲しくしてた子はいなかった?
lines.en: What a good group you're in. Nobody seemed unhappy?
lines.style: Gentle, attentive inquiry. Slight lift at the end, genuinely curious about the answer. Quiet care underneath—checking for the one who might be left out. Listening more than asking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ううん、皆全開で笑ってたよ。
lines.en: No, everyone was laughing really hard.
lines.style: Simple certainty. Proud that his class includes everyone. Straightforward delivery, no hesitation. The quiet confidence of someone who noticed and was glad.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 明日も、立ち上がりから元気に行こうね。
lines.en: Tomorrow too, let's start off with that same energy.
lines.style: Steady, affectionate close. Slightly slower pace. Not a command but an invitation. The kind of gentle anchoring a parent offers. Soft eye contact implied.
